candidate.answerReason: A quadratic function requires exponent 2 and a nonzero leading coefficient. The exponent condition gives m=2 or m=-1; the coefficient condition excludes m=-1.

methods.label: Apply the quadratic-function definition
methods.explanation: We require \(m^2-m=2\), or \((m-2)(m+1)=0\), giving \(m=2\) or \(m=-1\). Also, the coefficient of the quadratic term must satisfy \(m+1\ne0\), so \(m\ne-1\). Therefore, \(m=2\).
